# IPluginCondition

Namespace `AutoSettings.Sdk` · interface

```csharp
public interface IPluginCondition
```

A condition: must be true for an automation to run.

## Methods

### EvaluateAsync

```csharp
ValueTask<bool> EvaluateAsync(ConditionRequest request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
```

Checks the condition. It should be quick (well under a second); exceptions count as false.

| Parameter | Description |
|---|---|
| `request` | The parameters and the event being handled. |
| `cancellationToken` | Cancellation. |
